note: High-churn selector surfaces whose evidence predates the freshness limit. Shrinking this file is always allowed; growing it means a surface went stale without a recapture.

commentComposer.reason: YouTube only draws the comment box for a signed-in account.

feedExperimentChips.reason: The chip bar sits on the home feed, and a signed-out home page has no feed. Search's chips didn't render in the 2026-10-31 probe either.

feedPrompt.reason: Surveys and identity prompts only appear on a signed-in home feed. Only the signed-out feed nudge rendered on 2026-10-31.

feedSponsored.reason: Needs a served in-feed ad. None appeared on the signed-out pages the 2026-10-31 probe visited, so these names can't be confirmed or retired yet.

notifications.reason: The bell and its menu only exist for a signed-in account.

subscriptions.reason: These selectors matched the same grid on a channel's Videos tab on 2026-10-31, but the Subscriptions page itself needs a signed-in account.
